title: PresenterVideoSource
description: A presenter clip, normalised. Everything downstream of this point — transcription, cutting, overlays, composition, QA — is identical whether HeyGen generated the footage or a person recorded it.

audio_path.description: Extracted audio. Populated by the adapter when the source carries a single mixed track.

transcript_id.description: video_transcripts.audio_hash — the cached word-level transcript for this source.

has_alpha.description: True for a transparent-background avatar render, which can be composited over a designed background instead of a flat frame.

face_region.description: Where the presenter actually is in frame. Overlays are placed outside it, so the face is never covered.

takes.description: Multiple recordings of the same script. The editor picks the best take per line rather than assuming one continuous performance.
